script_text: A tidal wave of fate is crashing into your shell this week, Cancer. As the Moon, your ruling water planet, squares Pluto in your 7th House on Monday, power struggles with partners flare—avoid confrontations Tuesday when Mercury opposes Saturn in your 10th House, stalling career talks. By Wednesday, Venus sextiles Jupiter in your 2nd House, opening a lucrative freelance offer and softening love with a romantic dinner invitation. Midweek, the Sun enters your 1st House on Thursday, rebooting your identity and confidence after the earlier clashes. Over the weekend, Mars trines your North Node in the 5th House, sparking playful dates and creative cash flow from a side project. Wednesday is your power day because Venus sextiles Jupiter in your 2nd House. Monday is your worst day because the Moon squares Pluto in your 7th House. Sign contracts only after Thursday's solar shift. Follow for daily updates.
